horizon_disclosure: EPISODE_HORIZON_BARS = 24 is NOT source-grounded, NOT owner-approved, and NOT a market rule: it is a declared engineering parameter for bounded episode labeling.  It determines each label as the FIRST predefined observable event whose binding occurs on a completed task-scale bar inside the half-open window (as_of_bar, as_of_bar + 24]; episodes whose window extends past the available data are CENSORED, excluded, and reported — their labels are never guessed.  Sensitivity across alternative horizon values remains UNTESTED: no other defensible, explicitly declared configuration exists in this project, and no alternative values were invented or searched to improve the result.

source_examples.awaited_or_present_event: validation: "the high of the lowest down candle or price bar is traded through by a later formed candle or price bar"
context_at_decision_time: "the lowest candle or price bar with a down close that has the most range between open to close and is near a support level" — 'near support' is UNDEFINED (P-N) and 'the move' window is UNDEFINED (P-W)
source_examples.entry_and_invalidation_as_described: entry: "when price trades higher away from the bullish order block and then returns to the bullish order block candle or price bar high";  stop: "the low of the bullish order block is the location of a relatively safe stop loss placement";  stop management: "just below the 50 percent of the order block total range" (AMBIGUOUS UN-11)
source_examples.explained_only_after_outcome: not applicable: the lesson is procedural ("candles, validation, entries, stops"), not a statistical result (05 §5.7); no outcome-based case is used as evidence (08 §8.3)
source_examples.grade: P1 partial transcript (opening section; no timestamps; auto-caption artifacts; provenance caveats recorded)
source_examples.reference_selected: the order-block candle itself: its HIGH is the validation/entry level, its LOW is the stop level
source_examples.source: ICT Mentorship Core Content – Month 04 – Orderblocks (YouTube PIYh0CxoY9c; Dec-2016 content; uploader The Inner Circle Trader)

source_examples.awaited_or_present_event: trade-through validation of the block's high (P1 wording)
source_examples.context_at_decision_time: zone status transitions each require a bar and a knowability time (§5.8)
